premise: Robot gets to count down the rocket's engine test — but he counts up; Pilot patiently teaches him to count backwards, and then there's no stopping him.
inspiration: 'Ten Green Bottles' (the counting-down song), turned into a countdown that starts the wrong way round.
lesson: Patience turns a mistake into a lesson.

en-US.title: The Countdown
en-US.text: The {rocket:enter} {rocket:go to pad} rocket stood on the pad, ready for its engine test. {robot:enter} {robot:face happy} Robot had the most important job of all: the countdown. {pilot:enter} Pilot loped over, stood tall and {pilot:live} waved his glowing wands. All clear! Whenever you're ready. {robot:pulse} [excited] One! Two! Three! {pilot:face surprised} [laughs] Down, Robot, not up. {robot:face surprised} Down? {robot:shake} Ten, eleven, twelve… {pilot:face happy} Pilot sat him down. Backwards, he said. Like walking backwards. {robot:live} So Robot did a backwards dance and counted along: ten, nine, eight, seven, six, five, four… [slowly] three… two… one… ZERO! {canvas:dust 6s} {sfx:rumble} {rocket:live hold} The engines fired in a great cloud of dust. {robot:face happy} {robot:hop x3} [excited] Again! said Robot. And after that I'll count UP: one second, two seconds, three seconds of engines! {pilot:face happy} {pilot:shake} [laughs] That part, said Pilot, you're already very good at.

es-ES.title: La cuenta atrás
es-ES.text: El {rocket:enter} {rocket:go to pad} cohete esperaba en la plataforma, listo para probar los motores. {robot:enter} {robot:face happy} Robot tenía el trabajo más importante de todos: la cuenta atrás. {pilot:enter} Piloto llegó a zancadas, se plantó y {pilot:live} movió sus bastones luminosos. ¡Todo despejado! Cuando quieras. {robot:pulse} [excited] ¡Uno! ¡Dos! ¡Tres! {pilot:face surprised} [laughs] Hacia atrás, Robot, no hacia delante. {robot:face surprised} ¿Hacia atrás? {robot:shake} Diez, once, doce… {pilot:face happy} Piloto se sentó con él. Al revés, dijo. Como cuando andas de espaldas. {robot:live} Así que Robot bailó hacia atrás y contó: diez, nueve, ocho, siete, seis, cinco, cuatro… [slowly] tres… dos… uno… ¡CERO! {canvas:dust 6s} {sfx:rumble} {rocket:live hold} Los motores se encendieron en una gran nube de polvo. {robot:face happy} {robot:hop x3} [excited] ¡Otra vez! dijo Robot. ¡Y luego contaré hacia DELANTE: un segundo, dos segundos, tres segundos de motores! {pilot:face happy} {pilot:shake} [laughs] Eso, dijo Piloto, ya se te da de maravilla.

rumble.prompt: a deep, soft rocket engine rumble felt through the ground, steady and warm, not loud or scary
